recurringWork.title: Take a recurring task off my plate
recurringWork.description: Work out the right trigger, sources, and boundaries together. Try it once before deciding whether to keep it running.
recurringWork.designOnly: Pick an activity to save a plan. Designing it will not start an automation.
recurringWork.empty: No saved plans yet. Start with one task you find yourself repeating.
recurringWork.listError: Saved plans could not be loaded.
recurringWork.missing: This activity plan is no longer available.
recurringWork.planStatus: Design plan · check the linked runtime object for activation status

nextStep.draft: Continue the conversation to resolve the next decision.
nextStep.ready: Review the trigger, sources, permissions, and notifications before enabling anything.
nextStep.configured: Open the linked setup or run in this plan to check its actual status and results.
nextStep.needs_review: Confirm this plan's state in the conversation before preparing implementation.

recurringWork.beforeActivation: Preparing implementation reviews the exact configuration and may test a safe run. Ongoing execution starts only after the required confirmation.

prompts.start: Help me find and design one recurring activity I could delegate. First use what you know about my tools and channels, suggest a few grounded candidates, and ask only the next material question with a recommended answer. Reply and write the plan in English unless I ask for another language.
prompts.continue: Continue designing the recurring activity recorded in Note {noteId}. Read that Note first, preserve its confirmed decisions, and ask only the next material question with a recommended answer. Reply in English unless I ask for another language. Preserve the Note's existing language unless I ask to change it.
prompts.implement: Read and revalidate the full current recurring activity specification in Note {noteId}, even if its status says ready. Prepare its implementation using the smallest existing xopc product capabilities. If a material question remains, return the plan to draft and ask it with a recommended answer. Otherwise prepare and validate the required drafts, show the exact trigger, sources, permissions, and notifications, try a safe first run where possible, and request any required confirmation only after the plan is reviewable. Update the same Note with verified outcomes. Reply in English unless I ask for another language; preserve the Note's existing language.
